schema.years: Keyed by portal year (the spring window after that season ends; 2026 = players leaving after 2025-26). Newest edits are made directly in this file.
schema.row: Sheet-style field names kept for the site (YEAR, NAME, TEAM LEAVING, POS, YR., HOMETOWN, STATE/COUNTRY, HT, DESTINATION TEAM, NOTABLE, OLD CONF, NEW CONF, DATE ADDED, personkey) plus the fields below.
schema.status: left | withdrawn | returned. Withdrawn and returned players never actually left (entered the portal, then stayed or came back), so the site skips them for both outs and ins.
schema.destType: D1 | D3 | USports | Club | Pro | Unknown | Withdrawn. Derived from DESTINATION TEAM + NEW CONF; a blank destination stays Unknown, never guessed. D1 = a school in TopShelf's ALL_SCHOOLS list (standard names).
schema.qa: match: exact|fuzzy|manual|verified|verified-gap (how the personkey was reconciled with colrosters.json or checked by hand). conf: high|low (low = 2023/2024, not site-reconciled like the current seasons). pk_prev / name_prev: value before correction.
